description: Return the lat/lon edges of a neighborhood or rough area. Call this only when you need those edges. For trends, call get_area_trends with the place name and skip this tool. The suggested query is a short incident list, not a trend summary.

days.description: Days for the suggested incident list. Omit for a short default. Year-long trend windows belong on get_area_trends.

place.description: Neighborhood, street, borough, or a rough area such as downtown or north side.

primary_types.description: Optional crime types to carry into the suggested query.

name: resolve_place
